fields.help_en:
The name of the rule. Valid values:

`CommitMessageChecker`: A commit message rule.

`CommitAuthorEmailChecker`: A commit author email rule.

`CommitAuthorChecker`: A commit author rule.

`CommitCommitterChecker`: A commit committer rule.

`ForcePushChecker`: A rule that disallows force pushes.

`CommitFilesChecker`: A commit file restriction rule
fields.help_zh:
规则名称，可选值：
CommitMessageChecker：提交说明规则
CommitAuthorEmailChecker：提交邮箱规则
CommitAuthorChecker：提交作者检查
CommitCommitterChecker：提交人检查
ForcePushChecker：禁止强制推送检查
CommitFilesChecker：提交文件限制规则
fields.name: checker_name

fields.help_en:
Specifies the enforcement level for a code ownership check. This parameter is valid only for `CommitAuthorChecker` and `CommitCommitterChecker`. Valid values:

`warn`: Displays a warning but allows the push.

`block`: Blocks the push and returns an error
fields.help_zh:
该字段作用于代码属主检查下的限制级别设置，仅检查作者和检查提交者有效，其他规则可不传值，可选值：
warn：仅警告，允许推送
block：禁止推送
fields.name: checker_type

fields.help_en:
The behavior of this parameter varies based on the value of `checkerName`.

For the `CommitMessageChecker` rule, provide a regular expression to validate commit messages.

For the `CommitAuthorEmailChecker` rule, provide a regular expression to validate author email addresses.

For the `ForcePushChecker` rule, provide the value `"disabled"` to disallow force pushes.

For the `CommitAuthorChecker` rule, provide the value `"on"` to enable the check. Omit this parameter if the check is not required.

For the `CommitCommitterChecker` rule, provide the value `"on"` to enable the check. Omit this parameter if the check is not required
fields.help_zh:
在提交说明、提交邮箱、检查作者、检查提交人以及禁止强制推送时有效：
提交说明规则，extraMessage传入检查的正则表达式
提交邮箱规则，extraMessage传入检查的邮箱正则表示
禁止强制推送，extraMessage传入 "disabled"
检查作者规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
检查提交人规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
fields.name: extra_message

fields.help_en: An array of regular expressions to restrict file paths. This parameter is used only when `checkerName` is `CommitFilesChecker`
fields.help_zh: 该字段仅作用于提交文件限制，传入正则表达式，支持多条正则限制
fields.name: file_rule_regexes

`CommitMessageChecker`: commit message rule

`CommitAuthorEmailChecker`: commit author email rule

`CommitAuthorChecker`: commit author check

`CommitCommitterChecker`: committer check

`ForcePushChecker`: force push check

`CommitFilesChecker`: commit file limit rule

checkerType.description_en:
The enforcement level. This parameter applies only to the commit author check and committer check rules. Valid values:

`warn`: Warns the user and allows the push.

`block`: Blocks the push
checkerType.description_zh:
该字段作用于代码属主检查下的限制级别设置，仅检查作者和检查提交者有效，其他规则可不传值，可选值：

warn：仅警告，允许推送

extraMessage.description_en:
Additional information about the rule. The value of this parameter depends on the value of `checkerName`:

For the commit message rule, this parameter contains the validation regular expression.

For the commit author email rule, this parameter contains the regular expression for the email address.

For the force push check, this parameter is set to `disabled`.

For the commit author check, the value is `on` if the check is enabled.

For the committer check, the value is `on` if the check is enabled

检查作者规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
检查提交人规则，extraMessage传入 "on"，若不需要则不传值
